name: Wojo Live Rosin Disposable | Oishii
description:
Mother
Flavor Pack
Father
Moonbow F2
Oishii is Japanese for delicious, and we can't think of a more perfect name. Candy gas sounds a little generic, but is truly the best way to describe it. Zkittlez terps dominate, accompanied by a limey citrus and gas in the back. A potpouri of classic Archive Seeds terps, you can taste why they have become a staple in the solventless industry. Deceptively strong, Oishii dabs can feel like a light fruit dab at first but the high creeps in quickly. For that reason we recommend the Oishii strain for more experienced dabbers, during the day, or for use when you don't need to get anything done. Give your taste buds a vacation to paradise and give Oishii a try.
